observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== client_credentials backend ==="; TOK=$(curl -s -m 20 -X POST "http://localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/token" -H "Host: auth.localhost" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=backend&client_secret=cVBGgWNlbwSLydLZfZMvTvmNCeiSmLGP"); echo "$TOK" | head -c 300; echo; ACCESS=$(echo "$TOK" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{console.log(JSON.parse(s).access_token||'')}catch(e){console.log('')}})"); echo "token_len=${#ACCESS}"; echo "=== call protected /api/v1/regions with token ==="; curl -s -m 20 -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS" http://localhost:3000/api/v1/regions | head -c 800
